(nga )༄༅/ /rta mgrin yang phyung nag po'i sgrub thabs dbang bskur gyi cho ga rab dwangs me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dpal ldan thugs rje'i dbang phyug

tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// rta mgrin yang phyung nag po'i sgrub thabs dbang bskur gyi cho ga rab dwangs me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal ldan thugs rje'i dbang phyug khros pa'i sku// yid mkhar rnam par bkod pa'i 'phral nyid la// srid gsum dregs pa'i tshogs rnams 'dul mdzad pa// bla ma rta mchog he ru ka la 'dud// mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i thugs kyi kai la shar// yongs 'khyil zab gter rgya las spyan drangs pa'i// sgrub thabs rjes gnang cho ga nyang ral lugs// rgyas min tshig gi phreng bar rnam par spel// 'dir mnga' bdag nyang ral nas brgyud pa'i rta mgrin yang phyung nag po lcags ral can gyi sgrub thabs dang dbang bskur ba la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum/ dang po la'ang bsham dang sgrub thabs sngon 'gro gnyis las/ bsham ni stegs bu'i steng chos 'byung gru gsum me ri tshom bu bcas pa'am/ ma 'byor na nas kyi tshom bu bkod/ de'i steng man 'ji la dpal gtor nag po rgyan ldan la tsa ka li btsugs pa/ mdun du sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i 'bul gtor sman rak+ta/ mtha' mchod pas bskor ba sogs dgos pa'i yo byad bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu me tog rnams bzhag gnyis pa ni/ bgegs gtor btang*/ mtshams bcad/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la sgrub thabs dang dbang gi cho ga gnyis las/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas skad cig gis gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ drag po'i spyan gsum bgrad pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba bzhi rab tu gtsigs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dmar ser 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas pas sgrol byed kyi ral gris dgra bgegs mgo lus dum bur gtubs shing*/ g.yon pas 'dzin byed kyi lcags kyus dgra bgegs kyi srog snying 'dren pa/

zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i dor stabs kyis dgra bgegs mnan pa/ sku la dar nag gi ber chen gsol ba/ spyi gtsug nas rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis mnan pa/ sku stod la zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang*/ sku smad stag lpags kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal byas la/ ba spu'i gseb nas me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba/ bskal pa'i me dpung 'ur 'ur chem chem 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ dbu skra lcags kyi ral pa gsigs pa'i gseb nas khro chung gi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus/ khro bo'i gur khang du gyur pas phyogs kun khyab pas/ bsrung ba dang*/ bzlog pa dang bsad pa'i las mdzad par gyur zhes pas lhar bskyed de/ bzlas pa ni bdag gi thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' hūm̐ yig mthing ga sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas su bskor ba las 'od zer cher 'bar bas lus gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsreg shing sbyangs/ ba spu'i khung bu nas phyir 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad khro bo dang me dpung 'bar bas gnod byed thams cad ming gzhi tsam yang med par tshar bcad par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bsnyen pa'i sngags bung ba tshang 'tshol ba ltar 'bum phrag bcu bzla ba ni grangs bsnyen no// yak+ṣa nag po nṛ tri hur thum dzaḥganod byed mā ra ya srog la rbad rbad/ snying la rbad rbad/ rtsa la rbad rbad/ khrag la rbad rbad/ sha la rbad rbad/ rus la rbad rbad/ klad pa la rbad rbad/ yid la rbad rbad/ tsit+ta zung zung*/ tsit+ta rmugs rmugs/ tsit+ta phyung phyung*/ tsit+ta gtubs gtubs/ tsit+ta myogs myogs/ tsit+ta thum ril/ ya ya bh+yo/ srog rtsa chod chod/ snying rtsa phyung phyung*/ khaṃ khaṃ laṃ laṃ/ tshal par rbad rbad/ dum bur rbud rbud/ thum myogs bam ril/

mā ra ya rbad sod/ raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ u tsa ta ya phaṭa/ ces spu gri las kyi sngags te bsnyen sngags la btags te bzla ba ni sgrub pa'o// las sbyor ni las sngags rkyang pa bzla ba yin no gsung*/ thun 'jog khar dge ba bsngos la lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya'o// de'ang*/ sems nyid skye med stong gsal 'di// ye nas rang bzhin lha yi sku// dam tshig ye shes gnyis med la// bskyed bstim rgyas gdab mi 'tshal te// dran pa tsam gyis rdzogs pa nyid// lta ba gyad kyi lha zhes bya// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin 'di// bsrung ba kun gyi mchog yin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar bsgom pa'i rim pa'o// thun mtshams gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsregs gtor sbyangs nas/ thod pa'i snod du sman rag gtor ma rnams sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga dang dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag zhu ba las byung ba'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dpal rta mgrin nag po sde brgyad dregs pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ hūm̐ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje khros pa khro ba 'joms mdzad pa// khro mchog dbang gi rgyal po spyan 'dren na// dbang gi rta skad mtsher zhing gshegs su gsol// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ hūm̐ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dgra bgegs dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan stengs su// dbang gi rgyal po bcom ldan lha yi lha// mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ hūm̐ chags med skyon bral pad+ma rigs kyi lha// klu dbang tshul gyis gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa// rab brjid bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// khro rgyal rta mgrin sku la phyag 'tshal lo// na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥzhes pas phyag bya/

hūm̐ dug gsum dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag dang*// dug lnga sman sbyor bdud rtsi chen po 'di// khro mchog dbang gi sku la mchod pa 'bul// srid gsum gdug pa 'dul phyir bzhes su gsol// oṃ h+ya grī wa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+ta'i bar gyis spyir mchod/ khro bo'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs nas gsol bar bsams la/ rtsa sngags la/ yak+sha nag po dgra bgegs mā ra ya/ māṃ sa/ rak+ta/ tsit+ta/ go ro tsa na/ ba su ta/ keng nir ti ba lin+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ chos sku skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// longs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs rdzogs mdzad cing*// 'bar ba'i rgyal po dbang gi skur sprul nas// 'jig rten dregs pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku mdog mthing nag chos nyid 'gyur ba med// dar nag ber chen snang srid zil gyis mnan// spyi gtsug rta dbu sna tshogs phrin las rdzogs// bdud 'dul nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag g.yas ral gris dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod// g.yon pa lcags kyus ma rungs snying nas 'dren// lcags ral gseb nas khro chung sprul pa 'gyed// gnod byed gdug pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba rab tu gtsigs// spyan gsum khro gnyer smin ma glog ltar 'gyu// dpal gyi chas ldan me dpung klong na 'gying*// rab 'jigs dpa' bo che la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ gi nga ros khams gsum dbang du sdud// phaṭa kyi 'brug sgras log lta ma lus 'joms// rta skad drag pos dregs pa las la bskul// gsung mchog rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod// thugs nyid spros dang bral ba'i rang bzhin las// ye shes lnga yi mtshan ma cir yang ston// thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya che rol pa yi// yon tan phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod cing*/

hūm̐ thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// thugs rje'i dbang gis khro rgyal skur bstan pa// gar gyi dbang phyug khro bo kun gyi rje// ye shes sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs 'khor dang bcas// bka' yi pho nya dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs// sngon gyi khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du// thugs dam dbang gis gtor ma 'di bzhes la// dam tshig dbang gis rnal 'byor bdag cag skyongs// byang chub lam gyi bar chad sel ba dang*// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra dang bgegs la sogs// bdud dang log par 'dren pa thams cad la// mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ces phrin las bcol/ bsdu na/ bstod pa sh+lau ka gong ma gcig gi rjes su/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs kyis 'dod don gsol lo// yig brgyas nongs pa bshags/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs kyi mthar oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas gtor mgron gshegs su gsol/ smon lam gdab cing bkra shis brjod do// gnyis pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang slob ma la bya ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bdag mdun mnyam du bsgrub pa'am/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa bcas zin nas/ mchod pa dang sman rag gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsreg gtor sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dang sman rag gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha zhes pas sman dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭha zhes pas rak+ta dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba lin+ta ba la ba ti gu h+ya sid+dhi sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭha zhes pas gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa rnams lan gsum gsum brjod/ de nas rtsa sngags brjod pa'i rkyen gyis/

mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gtor ma dang bcas pa skad cig gis gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin zhes pa nas bskal pa'i me dpung 'ur 'ur 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ de'i spyi bor ā+oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dpal rta mgrin nag po sde brgyad dregs pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang zhes sogs nas bstod pa'i mthar thug pa sngar bzhin byas nas/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ yig mthing ga la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor ba dang*/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng me'i tshwa tshwa dang bcas pa zhal nas thon/ mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas thugs rgyud bskul/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu nas thon/ mdun bskyed kyi lte ba nas byung bdag gi lte bar zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim zhing mgal me ltar 'khor bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs par bsams la rtsa sngags brgya stong sogs ci nus dang sham bu btags pa'ang ci rigs bzlas mthar/ hūm̐ thugs rje chen po 'phags pa sogs kyis phrin las gsol lo// de dag gis slob dpon gyi bya ba grub nas/ slob ma'i bya ba la/ khrus byas/ bgegs bskrad la/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du byin rlabs dbang bskur zab mo zhus la don tshul bzhin nyams su blang bar bgyi snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas ma yengs par gsan 'tshal/ 'dir gsan par bya ba'i dbang ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje phrin las gcig tu gyur pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid/

zhi ba'i thabs kyis gdul dka' ba'i gdug pa can 'dul ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin shin tu khros pa'i skur bstan pa'i khro bo'i rgyal po ste/ de yang sgrub thabs rtsa ba'i gzhung las/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs rje'i phrin las gcig bsdus pa// 'gro ba'i don mdzad spyan ras gzigs// gang la gang 'dul sna tshogs ston// zhi bas mi 'dul gdug pa can// tshar gcod rta mgrin nag por bstan// de nyid shin tu khros pa ni// gnod sbyin nag po lcags ral can// dgra dang bgegs dang byad ma dang*// gza' klu rgyal bsen gnyen por bstan// zhes gsungs shing*/ de la sgrub thabs kyi bka' srol rnam grangs mang du bzhugs pa las/ thams cad kyi zab don snying po'i yang bcud logs su phyungs pas yang phyung nag po sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba au ḍ+yān gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis jo mo mtsho rgyal dang mnga' bdag khri srong la rnog chos su stsal ba yin te/ ji skad du/ dgra dang bgegs dang byad ma dang*// nad kyi rigs dang gdon gyi rigs// gnyan dang lhog pa thab rigs dang*// mdze dang shu 'brum skrang los dang*// smyo 'bog brgyal nad la sogs pa// gang dang gang la btab pa de// me dang rtswa sbur dpe bzhin du// bsregs shing rab tu sreg par byed// rlung dang thal ba'i dpe bzhin du// gtor zhing rab tu gtor bar byed// drag sngags bstan pa 'ga' yod kyang*// rno myur bstan pa 'di las med// ces dang*/ drag sngags kun gyi rno so yin// bya sla tshegs chung don che 'di// rjes 'jug don du zab par gdams// ma spel rin chen gter du sbos// zhes gsungs nas bsam yas mchims phu'i tshogs khang na gter du sbas pa/ mnga' bdag gi skye ba bcu gsum la nyang ral pa can gyis gter nas spyan drangs te rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma chad par rim par byon pa yin/

de lta bu'i rta mgrin gyi byin rlabs dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du slob dpon lhag pa'i lha dang tha mi dad pa la maṇ+ḍal phul zhes 'bul du gzhug maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bla ma dpal chen he ru ka /bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol// khro chen 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du// bdag cag rnams ni gzhug par 'tshal// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'i spyan sngar/ deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su 'gro snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas bzung ste byang chub bar// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// sems can ma lus kun don du// bdag ni rtag tu skyabs su mchi// zhes pas skyabs su song nas/ sems bskyed pa'i slad du/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin bsgrub snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// gzhan don sangs rgyas thob phyir du// khro mchog rta mgrin bsgrubs nas ni// bstan pa bsrung bar dam 'cha'o// zhes sems bskyed/ slar yang yul de dag thams cad la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu dus gsum thams cad kyi// bla ma skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum// yi dam dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// chos skyong srung ma la phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// sdig pa'i tshogs rnams mthol lo bshags// bdag gzhan dge la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// dge ba 'gro kun yongs la bsngo// zhes rgyud yongs su dag par byas nas/

dbang bskur byin rlabs kyi dngos gzhi'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dpal chen he ru ka dang gnyis med pa'i// rdo rje slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni dpal chen dbang gi sgor 'jug gi /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// dbang bskur byin rlabs stsal bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs rtsa ba'i sngags brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rnams skad cig gis pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa zhes pa nas/ chem chem 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar gyis dam tshig par bskyed/ gtor ma 'di nyid sngar ltar gsal btab pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bor gnas pa de nyid khyed rnams kyi spyi bor byon pas/ de'i sku'i cha thams cad nas khro bo 'chol ba sku chung la yan lag rags pa dpag tu med pa phyir 'phros/ phyi'i bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad/ khro bo rnams tshur 'dus khyed rnams kyi lus kyi cha thams cad nas thim pas lus thams cad gang*/ nang gi bar du gcod pa nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ lus sku rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag sngags drag tu brjod cing spos gtul rol mo bya/ de ni sku yi dbang yin no// yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ gtor ma bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin ye shes sems dpar gsal ba khyed rnams kyi mgrin par byon pas de'i zhal nas sngags kyi phreng ba dmar po me'i rang bzhin dmar 'ur 'ur byung*/ khyed rnams kyi khar zhugs/ lus thams cad dmar me'i gyis gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/

ngag gsung rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs par bsams la gtor ma mgrin par bzhag sngags dang spos rol bya/ sngags kyi bzlas lung gi slad du slob dpon la me tog 'thor ba dang bcas te 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rta mgrin bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon dpal rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig mthing ga sngags kyis bskor ba las sngags phreng rim pa gsum mar me gcig las gcig mched kyi tshul du byung zhal nas thon/ khyed rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar dang pos 'khod gnyis pa dang gsum pa de la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par mos la sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug me tog de slob dpon gyis sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rta mgrin 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// rta mgrin nag po'i byin rlabs dang sngags gsang sngags kyi nus mthu thams cad rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la 'jug cing brtan par gyur cig ces brjod/ de ni gsung gi dbang yin no// yang dmigs pa/ gtor ma bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin ye shes sems dpa' gsal ba khyed rnams kyi spyi bor byon pa 'od du zhu nas/ tshangs bug nas mar zhugs/ snying gar thim pas/ dpal rta mgrin gyi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang khyed rnams kyi sems dbyer med par chu dang 'o ma bsres pa ltar ro gcig tu 'dres pa dmigs med spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ gtor ma snying gar gtugs la spos rol/ de ni thugs kyi dbang yin no// de nas khyed rnams rta mgrin du gsal ba'i spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/

de la slob dpon gyis kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ wāka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gnas so sor bdud rtsir thig le bya'o// de ni yon tan gyi dbang yin no// de nas gtor ma rta mgrin du gsal ba khyed rnams kyi lag tu gtad de/ rdo rje slob ma khyed rnams la dpal rta mgrin gyi dbang bskur ba yin pas/ deng phyin chad yi dam lhar zung la sgom sgrub mchod la brtson pa dang*/ phrin las thams cad sgrub par gyis shig ces brjod ces pa de ni phrin las kyi dbang yin no// de rnams kyis dbang gi dngos gzhi rnams grub nas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdam bgyi snyam pas gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi ltar bya'o// gal te cung zad spros pa la dga' ba'am nad pa lta bu la khro bo char 'bebs kyi byin rlabs byed na/ sku'i rjes gnang gi skabs su/ gtor ma rta mgrin du gsal ba'i dpral ba na sku'i khro chung dkar po sku chung la yan lag rags pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rnams kyi dpral ba nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ nad gdon bar chad thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs par mos la/ sngags dang spos rol bya/ de bzhin du mgrin pa nas gsung gi khro bo dmar po sku chung la yan lag rags pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhugs lus thams cad gang sogs/ thugs ka nas thugs kyi khro chung sngon po/ snying ga nas zhugs/ sems kyi sogs/ lte ba nas yon tan gyi khro bo ser po/ lte ba nas zhugs sogs/ gsang ba nas phrin las kyi rta mgrin ljang gu spros gsang ba nas zhugs sogs gong ma'i rigs 'gre sbyar la gtor ma gnas gsum dang lag tu gtad/ gsung gi rjes gnang man chad ma byas kyang rung zhing*/ mthar gtor ma la rak+ta bran nas gnod byed gang yin pa de dgug gzhug byas la bstim/

bdud rtsis bran nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ rta mgrin 'khor dang bcas pas gsol bar bsams la gtor sngags kyis phul/ bstod cing phrin las bskul nas gnod byed kyi phyogs su zor du 'phang ba'am bsrung bya'i khang par bsrung ba'i don du 'jog pa gang bde bya'o// gal te nad pa sogs la dbang brgya tshar ram lo grangs lta bur byed na/ rgyas pa tshar gcig phrin las dbang gi mthar thug par byas mthar/ slar yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpal chen he ru ka dang sogs lan gcig gis gsol ba btab la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ gtor ma rta mgrin du gsal ba'i dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga lte gsang rnams nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi khro bo sku chung la yan lag rags pa dpag tu med pa dus cig car 'phros/ khyed rnams kyi sgo gsum lte gsang dang bcas pa rnams su cig car du zhugs pas lus thams cad gang*/ nad gdon bar chad thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs par mos la gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la sngags brjod cing spos dang rol mo bya'o// de lta bu la grangs bzung la bcu'am bco lnga sogs song ba na/ de ltar rta mgrin khro chung char 'bebs kyi byin rlabs dbang bskur grangs 'di tsam song bas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis brlabs nas mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ bzod par gsol ba gshegs shing bsdu ba dbang bskur bsngo ba smon lam shis brjod rnams sbyin pa 'dra bar bya'o// smras pa/ dbang drag phrin las 'khor lo sngon 'gro bas// srid gsum dregs byed brtan pa 'od srungs byin// mtha' dag rang dbang bkol ba sngags kyi mchog /rta mgrin lha'i rgyal po'i dbang bskur tshul// grub dbang mkhas pa'i zhal lung byin rlabs kyi// drod ldan bzhin gyi gzungs brnyan ma bsgribs par// rab dwangs yi ge'i me long 'di mthong tshe// 'phyang mo nyug blo stong pa'i bag la zha// ga pur rdul brtsegs lhun pos zla gzhon gyi// zil mngar lan brgyar 'thungs pas mtshon min pa'i// rnam dkar dge bas mkha' mnyam sems can kun// dngos grub zung gi dga' ston rol gyur cig

/ces rta mgrin yang phyung nag po'i sgrub thabs dbang bskur gyi cho ga rab dwangs me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mkhas btsun dam pa rnam rgyal bzang pos nan gyis bskul ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga la bha wan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
